rows.text:
RFC 9110, RFC 9111

Range requests are defined in RFC 9110 (HTTP Semantics, Section 14), and RFC 9111 (HTTP Caching) covers how caches handle partial content and range responses.

rows.text:
RFC 7617, RFC 9110, RFC 9111, RFC 9112

Correction: the Basic scheme itself is defined by RFC 7617, and the general HTTP authentication framework it builds on is RFC 9110. RFC 9111 and RFC 9112 are not part of the authentication specification, so the answer is:

RFC 7617, RFC 9110
